title: Ultimate Recipes
description: More useful than ever with 800+ new recipes
body:
### **Better stonecutter**


Ultimate Recipes brings over 300 fresh and practical recipes to the stonecutter! It also includes several quality-of-life improvements, like the ability to toggle between different variants of the same block, the option to transform log and stone into their plank versions and/or direct derivatives, and much more! Explore all the new and upgraded recipes in the menus below!




### **How to Install**
Decide if you want to download the pure Data Pack version version and follow the steps accordingly.


```
Data Pack
1) Download the Datapack
2) Chose the world you want to install the Data Pack in and navigate to its "datapacks" folder
3) Copy the downloaded Data Pack file (Ultimate_recipe) into this folder
4) Join the world and run /reload command
```
